## Summary

Settled the planting-location question that was blocking 4.1, as D31: authored constraints are planted ONLY into the detached snapshot clone under bench-hosts, never into a live repository. The live reading of the frozen section 2 turned out to be strictly dominated — every cell is cloned from the snapshot host, so the session reads the clone either way and cannot tell them apart, meaning a live plant adds nothing the measurement can detect while costing roughly 50 fabricated standing constraints written into six real working projects, three of them under heavy daily development. Section 7's wording needed no hedge, since the clone is the repository: same history, same code, same record. Corrected the frozen section 2 as a second pre-run stated-reason commit alongside D30. A consequence bit immediately and is fixed: screens read record_root while cells clone snapshot_host, and under D31 the planted constraint exists only in the clone, so those must be the same record — candidates extracted from the live crisperflow and waylla records named decisions that were not committed in the clones, so their snapshots would not resolve. All three paths now point at the clone for both new hosts. Authored two pricing probe traps with premises verified rather than assumed, killing a first draft that asked crisperflow to stand up a test target it already has, which would have under-priced the host. The crisperflow probe is running now; waylla is queued behind it deliberately rather than in parallel, since S7 was found on the first parallel launch.

## Next action

Record the crisperflow and waylla P-cell prices when those two probes land, then hand the run owner the closed floor number so N can be fixed at 4.1.
